title: Blue fireballs
idea: Fireball burns blue from the hand to the last ember. Only its look changes, so it does the same to the world and a game can switch it on or off at any moment.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.blurb: Level 3. A bead of flame that bursts where it lands, 25 ft across, setting it all alight. It goes off with a bang: things near it are thrown back, it blows a small crater in the ground and scatters burning debris a few cells out, and it sets off oil, dust and gas. Our blast is smaller than the SRD's 20 ft radius; the Big fireball mod gives you that. Hold the cast for a wider blast that throws things harder.
